In the air... WIDE OF LEG GULLY! Wagner hurries up the batsman with a well-directed short ball around leg, Burns is caught in an awkward position as he tries to fend it off. The ball takes the splice of his bat and flies wide of the diving gully fielder for a run. Eventful over, 8 coming off it!

Ouch, that would have hurt! Wagner bangs in a short ball in the line of the stumps, Rory probably picks it very late and has no time of moving away. It hits him flush on the chest! Showing no pain, Burns.

Fifty partnership! Wagner angles in a full length ball around off, shaping in a bit, Burns brings down a straight bat and works it off the inner half. It races past the right side of the mid-wicket fielder and Daryl Mitchell gives the chase. He slides near the fence to pull it back and the batsmen collect a couple of runs. 50-run stand comes up between the two, the deficit is exactly 300 now!
Wagner returns to over the wicket line but still delivers a short ball on middle, Root pulls in front of square leg this time and collects a single.

FOUR! No stopping this one! Wagner bangs in a short ball around off, angling in, Root turns inside the crease and pulls it firmly behind square leg for a cracking boundary. Joe is looking comfortable whenever it is pitched short to him.
Wagner steams in from 'round the wicket and slants in a length ball on off, Root remains on the back foot and presents a vertical bat in defense.
Fuller and a little bit of shape as it lands on off, Rory pushes it down with a straight bat to mid on.
Short in length and wide outside off, Burns drops his wrists and sway away.
A touch short and angling in from outside off, Rory goes on the back foot and defends it right under his watchful eyes.
Good rotation of wrists by Burns as he flicks a full ball on the leg side. The mid-wicket fielder stops it with a full length dive.
Good length ball on off, Burns defends it off his back foot.
FOUR LEG BYES! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, angling down, Burns fails to glance it across the line and it goes off his thigh pad to the fine leg fence.
Sliding down the leg side, Burns flicks it behind square leg for a single. A mixed-bag first over by Neil this morning.
Short in length on off, Root once again eases it through his pull shot to deep mid-wicket. Another run added to the scoreboard.
Bouncer outside off, Root ducks although the line was quite wide. It didn't bounce much there.

Yet another bouncer by Wagner. Around leg and Burns fails to duck underneath it properly. It hits him on the shoulders and loops behind the keeper. The fine leg fielder makes a sliding stop near the fence and the batsmen steal a leg bye.
Bangs it in on middle, Root loves hanging on the back foot and swivels to pull it to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Wagner starts with a delivery on the pads, Rory shuffles across a bit and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
First bowling change of the day. Neil Wagner comes on to bowl. He replaces Matt Henry.
Fuller length ball on middle, Joe drives it down the ground but straight to mid on.

Too full and around off, shaping away a bit, Root without moving his front foot much pushes it towards mid on. It's quite a questionable footwork by Joe. Sooner or later he might find himself in trouble.
Better this time. Southee delivers a full ball around off with the seam pointing towards first slip, Root keeps his weight on the back leg as he pushes it to mid off.
Plenty of outswing on this delivery right from the moment Southee releases the ball. But the line is too wide outside off to bother the English skipper.
Drifting down the leg side with the angle, Root works it through square leg and returns for the second run.
Serves it on a driving length outside off, Root shows a lot of restrain as he makes a leave.
Beaten! Henry hurls across a length ball just outside off, Burns tries to defend it off his front foot but it straightens off the seam and beats the outside edge.
Back of a length ball on middle, that's the length Root likes and he nudges it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
A near yorker on off, Root once again jams it out without getting entirely forward.
Full and angling in on middle, Root turns it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Fullish and around off, a hint of away shape, Root stays back and defends it with a loose bottom hand. Sums up the batting form of Joe. That was quite full but Root still stayed on the back foot.
A pitched up delivery outside off, Root played a mistimed off drive and Henry stopped it with his left hand in his followthrough.
Southee loses his radar and delivers a full length ball down the leg side, Root flicks it behind square leg. Henry moves across to his left in the deep and they cross for a single.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Root covers his stumps and allows it through to the Kiwi keeper.
Southee goes full and lands it just outside off, Root has his weight on the back leg and just lunges to defend it on the off side.
Back of a length delivery just outside off, at 131.6 kph, Root lets it through to the keeper.
Full and angling down the leg side, Burns flicks it through square leg for a single.
Fullish and on off, angling in, Burns brings down a straight bat and keeps it out off the inner half. It rolls away to one of the two short mid-wicket fielders.
Good length ball on top of off, Root defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Root was in no control! Henry bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Root hangs on the back foot to pull but it rises on his bat and takes the top edge. The ball runs fine down the leg side for a boundary. There are a couple of fielders deep on the leg side waiting for a mishit. Joe is lucky this time!
This time Henry brings a length ball back into the right-hander. Root remains on the back foot and keeps his eyes on the ball as he blocks it to the off side.
A probing line and length. On and around off, shaping away a shade, Root doesn't commit himself on the front foot entirely and just pushes it with gentle hands to cover-point.
The length is on the fuller side this time, angling in around off, Root brings down a straight bat and with minimum footwork drives it to mid off.
Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Root shoulders arms.
Lands it on a length close to off, Burns defends it from the crease to the on side.
Pitches it up and around off, angling in, Burns leans forward and pushes it down to mid on.
Digs in a short delivery on middle at 127 kph, Root turns and pulls it behind square leg for a single. 50 up for England!
Once again a delivery with a hint of away shape. It pitches outside off and Joe shoulders arms.
Gets close to off stump with an outswinger, Root is on the front foot as he pushes it towards mid off.
A gentle loosener by Southee. On a length and wide outside off, further moving away from the batsman. Root has an easy leave to make.
Good length ball on off, Rory is on the back foot as he plays it down towards mid on.
EDGY FOUR! Fuller length ball outside off, holding its line after landing, Burns gets forward to defend but it takes the outside edge and runs wide of the slip cordon for a boundary.

Injury zone - News from the medical team about Jack Leach and Dominic Sibley has come in. Jack Leach has not been discharged from the hospital after reports of Gastro. As for Dominic Sibley, he was hit on the helmet by a bouncer bowled by Southee on Day 2. He too is still being monitored as a precautionary measure for a delayed concussion.
Henry angles in a length ball on middle, looking for an away swinger from there. But the line turns out to be too straight and Root eases it behind square leg for a single.
Hurls across a length ball outside off, Root has nothing to do with it.

FOUR! This will make Root feel a lot better about himself with the bat. Back of a length ball outside off, Joe transfers his weight on the back foot and steers it behind square on the off side for a boundary.
Starts his spell with a good length ball in the zone outside off. A hint of away shape there as well. Root makes a sensible leave.
Matt Henry to operate from the other end.
Angling in a length ball close to off, Burns defends it well to end the over.
Full in length outside off, Burns is solidly behind the line as he blocks it soundly.
Tim switches to 'round the wicket and delivers a back of a length ball on off, Burns is on his toes in defense.
A touch short and outside off, Root goes back and taps it down to the right of gully for a quick single. England are away on Day 3!
Just a hint of swing on this occasion as Southee serves a fuller length ball close to off stump. Root pushes it out with an angled bat to covers.
Southee begins with a good length delivery in the channel outside off, Root watches it closely before making a leave.

The sun is shining down at Seddon Park. It's time to get underway! Almost 3277 km away from Hamilton, David Warner cracked a triple ton in Adelaide. Currently, the deficit for England is one run more than Davey's highest Test score now and it's a tall task in front of them to wipe it off. England skipper Joe Root and Rory Burns walk out to the middle along with the New Zealand players. Tim Southee will start the proceedings. Here we go...

Pitch report - Mark Richardson is down there inspecting the third day's pitch. Richardson says he has noticed that there are some changes on the surface. States that the track has started to show signs of wearing out. Cracks have started to appear on the pitch and that will be something to look out for Santner.

Hello and welcome everyone as we step into the moving day of the second Test match in Hamilton. New Zealand have gained the upper hand after dominating the first two days and will be eager to keep their momentum going. England, on the flip side, are under the pump again and now they are dependent on their misfiring batting to bail them out. Already two wickets down, a big effort is required from the middle order. Rory Burns is lucky to be still out there after a couple of dropped catches and he would try to make the Kiwis pay for it. All in all, a very vital day of this Test is about to get underway. Stay with us for all the updates.
... DAY 3, FIRST SESSION ...

Right then, it's time to bid you goodbye. Do join us at 1030 local (2130 GMT, Previous day) as there will be half an hour early start again to make up for the lost overs on Day 1. You can now hop over to the concerned tab to get all the updates from the Adelaide Test where David Warner is nearing a triple century. Cheers!

Interview time! Daryl Mitchell, the debutant and star with the bat for New Zealand, says it was nice to contribute. Tells that England bowled well and he just kept his patience. Smiles and says that it was nice to get runs and spend time in the middle. Adds that it's always fun to bat with Watling as he keeps it nice and calm. Reckons that there is some extra bounce in the pitch and hopes to make use of that on Sunday.

Tim Southee and Matt Henry bagged a wicket each and a couple of catches also went down off their bowling. Had they been taken, England would have been in a more precarious situation. They have their backs to the wall and need Joe Root to stand up and show them the way. The deficit for them is quite big but New Zealand have shown that it's not too tough to score runs on this surface.

It was a really tough day for England. They struggled with the ball and lacked intensity in the field. The English bowling was completely flat and only Stuart Broad managed to make things happen. He finished with a 4-wicket haul while Chris Woakes also picked up three wickets. There were talks about the pitch to be on the flatter side but the Kiwi bowlers turned up with the ball and showed that there is some spice in the surface.

End of an extraordinary day of Test cricket! New Zealand have thoroughly enjoyed it again and are right on top. The day didn't start well for them but they didn't let that hamper their momentum. BJ Watling and Daryl Mitchell formed a strong alliance to put together a century stand and then some handy contributions from the lower order zoomed the Kiwi total to 375.

An interesting last ball of the day. Short ball down the leg side, Root rocks back and looks to pull with control. The ball though goes a bit uppishly and wide of the leg gully fielder towards fine leg. Joe Root survives and takes a single. Nervy way to end proceedings. That will be STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Length ball outside off, left alone by Root.
On the hips again, worked towards fine leg for a single.
Bowls from 'round the wicket now, on the hips of Burns who tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, driven towards mid off.
Down the leg side, Burns looks to flick this one but misses.
Length ball outside off, played towards point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball on middle and off, Burns pushes this one down the ground. Williamson from mid off runs across and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. The batters complete one.
Again outside off, left alone by Burns.
Another one outside off, Burns shoulders arms.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Daryl Mitchell, the local lad and debutant, who scored a half ton while batting has come on to bowl now. He will surely be carrying an extra spring in his step.
Length and around off, Root defends it off the full face of the bat towards the off side.
Length and down the leg side. Root lets it be.
Length and around off, Root blocks it to the off side from within the crease.
Length and on middle and leg, Root stays back and taps it down in front of leg gully.
Length and on the pads of Burns. He flicks it through square leg for a run.
Poor start first up. Wagner bowls a bumper but it is way down the leg side. Burns is not interested to play as he ducks it.
Neil Wagner replaces Matt Henry into the attack. There is a slip, short leg and leg gully in place. Short stuff coming?
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Good shot by Root! On the pads, he flicks this one with ease towards the empty mid-wicket region. Jeet Raval in the deep runs to his left in an attempt to stop the ball from going over the fence but fails to do so.
Good length ball on the off pole line, defended towards the cover region.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Good length ball angling into the southpaw, Burns shuffles across and works this one towards mid-wicket for a single. They wanted the second there but it was not available.
Outside off, pushed to covers by Root.
Length delivery on off, defended back to the bowler off the front foot.
On a middle and leg line, Root flicks it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Henry dishes one on length and Root pushes it towards covers.
Yorker on middle and leg, Root just about manages to bring his bat down in time and keeps it out to the leg side.
Length and around off, defended to covers.
Full ball on off, punched towards cover and Root takes a single to get off the mark.
On the pads, Root works this one towards mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

DROPPED! A tough chance but put down again and Burns gets another life. Southee bowls this one on middle and off, Burns goes across and flicks this one uppishly towards short mid-wicket. Jeet Raval stationed there flies to his left, gets two hands to it but fails to hold on. Raval looks disappointed to have dropped that after getting both his hands behind the ball. This is the second time that Burns has been dropped in this innings and one can feel his nerves jangling.
Outside off, left alone.
Bouncer on middle and off, Burns sways away from it.
Another one on middle and leg, driven towards mid on.
Henry attacks the stumps but Root is solid in his defense and plays this one towards the off side.
On middle and leg, played back to the bowler.
Fullish ball on off, blocked out.
Full ball on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
Good length ball around off, watchfully defended.
Good length ball just outside off, worked towards mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, pushed towards the man at short cover.
Around off, left alone.

FOUR! Lucky, very lucky for Burns. Southee serves him a ball on the driving length outside off and Rory obliges. But he gets a thick inside edge which runs past the off pole and past the keeper's dive to his right. The ball races to the fine leg fence.
Good length and around off, Burns shoulders arms to it.
Bumper from Southee and Burns has to duck it awkwardly.
Good length ball on middle and off, Root prods forward and defends.
Joe Root, the English skipper, walks out now. His team needs a big innings from him now more than ever.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! That is a superb take by the keeper and Denly departs now. Henry bowls a length ball just on the off pole line. It pitches and holds its line. Denly looks to defend with unsure footwork and the ball takes the outside edge. It goes low to the right of the Kiwi keeper, BJ Watling. He dives in that direction and holds onto the ball with both hands. Double blow for the English team and it looks like New Zealand are bowling on a track completely different from the one where the England bowlers were bowling.
Length ball outside off, nipping back in. Denly leaves it alone as it misses the off pole by a small margin.
Yorker by Henry, Denly does well to dig that out back towards the bowler.
On middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Good length ball just outside off, Denly pushes this one towards point.
Another full ball on off, hit straight to the man at cover.
FOUR! Creamed! This time Burns gets this one out from the middle of the bat as he prods forward and drives this full ball through the covers for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed towards cover-point.
On off again, pushed towards point.
Length ball on middle and off, defended out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

DROPPED! Ross Taylor is the culprit! Usually a very safe pair of hands but Taylor has dropped this one. Henry bowls a full delivery wide outside off, the sucker ball. Burns goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge on it. The ball flies towards the right of first slip where Ross Taylor is positioned. He moves in that direction, gets two hands to it but the ball pops out of his hands. It rolls towards the fine leg region and the batters take a single. Life given to Burns and he should be looking to make the most of it now.
A pitched up ball outside off, driven off the front foot by Burns to mid off.
Henry angles across a good length ball outside off, Rory makes an easy leave.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Rory works it around on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
FOUR! Drives and drives well! Just a little too full from Henry. It's just outside off and Burns strokes it crisply down the ground for a boundary at long off.
Denly prods forward and defends this one off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Good start to the innings for Denly! On the pads, Denly flicks this one nonchalantly through mid-wicket for a boundary. He is off the mark on the first ball.
Joe Denly walks out to bat at number 3. A lot of responsibility is on his shoulders to see off the remaining 15 overs or so for England without any further casualty.

OUT! This time Dominic has been given lbw! Early blow to the England innings as Dominic Sibley departs. Southee bowls a full ball on middle and leg. Sibley shuffles across a bit and looks to flick this one fine down the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. The New Zealand players appeal in unison and umpire Dharmasena raises his finger. Sibley has a chat with his partner about the review but they decide against it. The only thing that could have saved Sibley there was an inside edge and Sibley might be suggesting that he did not hit it. Replays later roll in and show THREE REDS. A good decision not to take the review.
Down the leg side, Sibley looks to flick but misses.

Stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire! Southee bowls a length ball just outside off with a scrambled seam. It nips back in, beating the defense of Sibley. He is hit almost on the box but the Kiwi players put in an appeal. Dismissed by the umpire. Too high for lbw!
Length ball just outside off, well left by Dominic.
Good length ball outside off, pushed straight to the man at cover.
Fuller ball on off, driven towards the man at mid off.
A length delivery on off, Rory covers everything necessary and blocks it down safely.
Gets behind the line and punches it down the ground. The mid on fielder gives the chase and they take a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Sibley glances it off his hips through square leg for a run.
Burns shoulders arms to get through the over.
Full ball on off, pushed towards mid off.
Another one outside off, Burns shoulders arms.
Length ball outside off, scrambled seam this time. Left alone again by Burns.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
On the pads, flicked towards the square leg region for a single.
Fullish ball on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball just on middle and off, Sibley looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat towards point for a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, Sibley defends it into the ground.
Full ball on middle and off, defended back towards the bowler.
Bouncer outside off, Sibley sways away from it.
Full ball on off, Sibley pushes this towards the man at extra cover.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Southee overpitches it outside off and Burns just leans into the drive. He thumps it from the middle of his bat and sends it speeding away through covers for a boundary.

Nearly a run out at the bowler's end! Fullish and on off, a hint of late inward movement, Sibley pushes it back to the bowler who goes down low and gets his fingertips on the ball. It runs behind to disturb the stumps but the non-striker was alert in parking his bat inside the crease. Everybody involved in this delivery and Sibley did really well there!

Physio comes out to perform the mandatory concussion check. The camera has panned to the steward who also took a blow on his head when Santner hit a six a little while back. He was hit flush on his cap but is doing well. Meanwhile, Sibley is also getting ready to resume his innings. He has changed his head gear.

BANG ON THE HELMET! Poor technique shown by the batsman. Southee digs in a short ball, well-directed, Sibley picks it very late, tries to duck and get away from the line but ends up taking a blow on the helmet. The ball deflects towards cover-point and they cross for a leg bye. Got into a really awkward position, Dominic. He was opened up in his stance trying to duck and sway but the ball kept on following him and struck him on the helmet.
Fullish and outside off, driven off the front foot but straight to mid off.
Serves a full length ball close to the off stump line, it straightens a touch, Sibley gets forward and blocks it with a vertical bat.
An outswinger by Southee, on a length and outside off, Dominic picks the line early and makes an easy leave.
Henry runs in from 'round the wicket and angles in a full ball on middle, Burns meets it with a straight blade and defends it back.
England are away! A delivery sliding down the leg side has been deflected to fine leg for a run.
Bowls it full and around off, Sibley gets forward and across before flicking it on the leg side. Good timing but the placement is not there. Straight to mid-wicket.
This one is on a driving length outside off, Sibley shuffles across slightly and then makes a leave.
Hurls in a length ball in the channel outside off, Sibley allows it through.
Fuller in length on off, angling in, Sibley gets behind the line and pushes it down towards mid on.
Matt Henry to share the new ball from the other end.
On a length around off, Burns gets behind the line and pushes it to mid off. Maiden!
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Burns has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pitches it up and outside off, Rory drives it confidently off his front foot but finds mid off.
Too full in length on middle and leg, Burns pushes it towards mid on.
Southee begins with a good length delivery in the zone outside off, Burns watches the line closely and shoulders arms.
